title: convolvulus pomaceus
intro: Convolvulus pomaceus, commonly known as the Indian snail vine, is a plant species that belongs to the family Convolvulaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus pomaceus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation, preventing infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
